literal: Water too of the shade is sweet indeed; feigned anger too with those who love is sweet.
translation: Just as water is sweet when it is in the shade, a lover's tiff is sweet only when it is with those who truly love us.
modern: நிழலில் உள்ள நீரே குடிக்க இனியது; அதுபோல, நம்மை விரும்புபவர்களிடம் கொள்ளும் ஊடலே இன்பம் தருவதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a beautiful analogy to explain the nature of a lover's tiff (புலவி). Water is naturally refreshing, but it is exceptionally sweet and cool when drawn from the shade rather than from an open, sun-baked area. Similarly, while love itself is sweet, a minor feigned disagreement or lover's quarrel is delightful only when it occurs with a partner who truly loves and cherishes us. The word 'வீழுநர்' refers to those who love, emphasizing that the sweetness of the tiff depends entirely on the mutual affection of the partners.
